name: Visual Error Tomography (VET)
definition: VET is a technique to identify incomplete regions of a scene by computing per-pixel rendering loss, processing these error images with a CT reconstruction module to create a volumetric model of visual error, and spawning new points in high-error regions.
summary: Visual Error Tomography identifies and fills geometric holes in 3D point clouds by lifting 2D rendering errors into 3D space via tomography, effectively handling large-scale gaps without generating unnecessary points.
